transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I'm just here because... well, I can't seem to stop my mind from racing. It's just constant. I'm a lab tech right now, and we just got this new partnership, and I keep thinking they're going to cut my position. Or that my data is wrong. And then I start thinking about my bills piling up, and... I don't know, my family thinking I'm falling behind. I just keep worrying that I've already ruined my chances at getting into grad school. It's just a lot.
Have you been avoiding any situations or activities because of these worries?
Um... no, not really. I still go to the lab and everything. I just... I don't know. I just worry while I'm there.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?
No... not really. I mean, I get tired from all the thinking, I guess. But I wouldn't say I feel sad. Just... wound up.
Have you been experiencing any physical symptoms like headaches or stomach problems?

Um... yeah, I guess I get headaches. Mostly in the evening. I think it's just because my... my shoulders and neck stay really tight during the day. I'll catch myself just clenching my jaw while I'm staring at spreadsheets. So by the time I get off work, my head hurts and I'm just stiff. Kind of feels like I've been hauling heavy lab equipment around all day, even if I haven't.
Has something very upsetting or traumatic happened to you recently?
Um... no. Nothing like that. Just... normal stuff, I guess.
Have you been avoiding social gatherings or meetings with friends and family?
Not really. I mean... I still see people sometimes. I just don't go out a whole lot anyway, so... no, I wouldn't say I'm avoiding anyone.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating over and over in your mind?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean... I'll try to just tell myself to focus on one task at work, like... finishing a report or checking an assay. But... it's hard. One thing just kind of sets off another. And pretty soon I'm just... staring at the screen, and my head is just running through every possible way things could go wrong.
Do you feel like you're trying to ignore or suppress these repeating thoughts?
I mean... I try. But... it doesn't really work. I just... I don't know, I just try to get through the day.
Do you feel like you have to repeat certain actions or behaviors to reduce your anxiety?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I do anything like that. I mostly just... sit there. So... no.
Do you feel like these repeating thoughts are intrusive or unwanted?
I mean... yeah. I definitely don't want them. They just... they just happen. I don't really know what else to say about it.
Has there been a traumatic event in your past that you haven't mentioned yet?
Um... no. Nothing like that. Just... normal stuff, I guess. Nothing traumatic.
Do you feel like these thoughts are interfering with your daily activities?

Yeah... I guess so. Work is... it's been hard. I actually missed an internal deadline at the lab recently. I just... I couldn't get my data and writing organized. And... I don't know, even normal stuff. Preparing reports, or... going to art nights... cooking for my family. It all just feels like too much to keep up with right now. So... yeah.
How long have you been experiencing these racing thoughts and worries?

Um... maybe about seven months? Give or take. It started around the time the lab had a... a funding shift. We got a new commercial partnership and it just changed how everything was being run. So... yeah, since then, I guess.
Do you feel compelled to perform any specific mental acts or rituals in response to these intrusive thoughts?
No... not really. I don't... I don't do anything like that. Just... just the worrying, I guess.
Do you feel like these racing thoughts are about things that could happen in the future, or are they more about things that you think are wrong or that you need to fix right now?
Um... mostly the future, I think. Just... what could go wrong. What if I mess up the new project, or... what if I can't keep up. That kind of thing.
Do you feel like these thoughts are obsessive, meaning they're thoughts that you try to ignore or suppress but keep coming back to?
I don't know if I'd call them... obsessive. I just... I try not to think about it, but I do anyway. It's just worrying. I don't know.
Do you feel like these worries and thoughts are in line with your own values and beliefs, or do they feel alien or inconsistent with who you are?
I mean... they feel like me, I guess. It's just... my brain, worrying about my life. It doesn't feel weird or... alien. Just... exhausting.
Do you feel like you have to do certain things over and over to reduce your anxiety or prevent something bad from happening?
No... I don't think so. I don't really do anything like that. I just... worry.
Do you feel like these worries are something that a part of you wants to think about, or are they something you wish you could stop thinking about?

I definitely wish I could stop. I don't want to think about any of it. I'll try to just... tell myself to focus on one task at work, like finishing a report or checking an assay. But... one worry just kind of sets off another one. And pretty soon I'm just staring at my computer screen, and my head is just running through every possible way things could go wrong. I can't really turn it off.
Have you noticed that your worries and anxiety seem to be triggered by or closely related to the changes at work with the new partnership?

Yeah, I guess so. It started around... maybe seven months ago? That's when the lab's funding shifted and the commercial partnership happened. It just... changed how everything was run. So, yeah, it's been about that long.
